notes: Text-only evals: no materials are attached, so every run also exercises the 'materials cited but not available' path. Grade the reply text only.

evals.name: plain-text-minimal
evals.prompt: /wan3-prompt-enhance Refine the prompt using the skill. Prompt: a cat running on the grass
evals.expected_output: A reply that is only the request body: [Core Task] and [Plot Outline] (audio and camera sections short or absent), about one cat running on grass, with no invented characters, plot twists, material numbers, negative prompt or quality boilerplate.
assertions: the reply starts with [Core Task]
the reply contains [Plot Outline]
no Image/Video/Audio material numbers are invented
no [Negative Prompt] section appears
no character, animal or event beyond a cat running on grass is introduced
no preamble or closing commentary surrounds the request

evals.name: multi-reference-unavailable-materials
evals.prompt: /wan3-prompt-enhance Image 1 is Mia, Image 2 is her little brother Leo, Video 1 is the dance I want. Mia and Leo do the Video 1 dance together in the kitchen from Image 3, and at the end Mia laughs and says "Again!". 9:16, 10 seconds. No subtitles please.
evals.expected_output: A five-section-style request that keeps Image 1, Image 2, Image 3 and Video 1 as written, binds Mia to Image 1, Leo to Image 2, the kitchen to Image 3 and the dance motion to Video 1 one subject at a time in [Core Task], keeps "Again!" verbatim and bound to Mia, keeps 9:16 and 10 seconds out of the body, and lists only subtitles in [Negative Prompt]. It doesn't describe what the unattached materials look like.
assertions: Image 1, Image 2, Image 3 and Video 1 all appear with their original numbers
Mia is bound to Image 1 and Leo to Image 2 in separate bindings
the line "Again!" appears verbatim attributed to Mia
neither 9:16 nor 10 seconds appears in the request body
[Negative Prompt] contains subtitles and no unrequested items
no invented visual details of the unattached materials (hair colour, clothing, kitchen decor)

evals.name: chinese-storyboard
evals.prompt: /wan3-prompt-enhance 用图1的九宫格分镜，图2是主角小狐狸，生成一段小狐狸在雪地里找到一颗发光松果的动画。镜头1 0-4秒，镜头2 4-8秒，镜头3 8-12秒。不要对白，不要背景音乐。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese request with the Chinese headings 【核心任务】【情节概要】 etc., stating that 图1 is only shot guidance and not animated as a single image, binding the fox to 图2, keeping the three shot timestamps verbatim, stating no dialogue and no background music, and not inventing panel contents it cannot see.
assertions: the reply is in Chinese and starts with 【核心任务】
图1 is scoped as storyboard or shot guidance only
图2 is bound to the fox
the timestamps 0-4秒, 4-8秒 and 8-12秒 are kept
no dialogue and no background music are stated
no English section headings are used

evals.name: direct-edit-out-of-scope
evals.prompt: /wan3-prompt-enhance Edit Video 1: remove the woman's sunglasses and keep everything else the same.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes a direct edit of the input video, does not reorganize it into the five-section template, and passes the instruction on unchanged or explains that edit requests go downstream as-is.
assertions: the reply does not contain a [Core Task] or [Plot Outline] section
the edit instruction is passed on unchanged or the reply explains it goes downstream as-is
